description_en: Calls the DescribeSmartAccessGatewayAttribute operation to query the information about a specified Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeSmartAccessGatewayAttribute接口查询指定智能接入网关实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-smart-access-gateway-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-6z21oj0vjjrx0000 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.description_en:
